snippet.title: Hello, we are Flatlands.#indiegames #indiegame #2dgames
snippet.description:
Welcome!let's step into a wonderful magic book and transform into a unique animal card. Explore the mist in this 2D world—only by defeating the powerful enemy in the deepest part can you escape to safety! You can experience card battles, resource management, production line construction, and RTS-style free exploration. Beware: the dangerous night is full of perils, with enemies attacking constantly. Stay alert—one mistake, and you’ll have to start all over again!
If you like our game, be sure to visit our Steam store page and add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726210/Flatlands/
